scientific_integrity: Analytic finite-dimensional proof; code supplies only finite-sample sanity checks. Novelty and priority are assessed relative to inspected literature, not certified globally.
scientific_limitations: Two-mode equal-weight pure Fourier input, commuting vertex shifts, independently resampled common global Haar coin; no multi-mode, localized-input, or pathwise-convergence theorem. General Haar 2-design identities are known ingredients.
title: Exact trajectory-purity memory in Haar-random coined walks on Abelian Cayley graphs
